name: Heaven Hug AI: Run Into Their Arms Above the Clouds
blurb: The heaven hug is an AI video trend where you run up a stairway of light or across golden clouds and hug a loved one who has passed away.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 10 s, 720p, 9:16, sound on. The video prompt
prompts.text:
A tender, emotional reunion above the clouds, filmed like a real film: a soft white sea of clouds stretches to the horizon under a pale golden-hour sky, with warm sunbeams breaking through the clouds. Photorealistic, natural skin and natural colors, gentle film grain, warm golden light, not CGI, not a cartoon, not a painting. Medium shots and close-ups keep both faces large, sharp and well lit.

The one who arrives is the person in [Image 1], in every frame: copy the exact face from [Image 1] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles), with the clothes from [Image 1].
The one who waits is the person in [Image 2], in every frame: copy the exact face from [Image 2] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles), at the age shown in [Image 2], with the clothes from [Image 2]. They look healthy, calm and at peace. If [Image 2] is an old or black-and-white photo, they appear in natural full color with the same face.
If [Image 2] shows two people, both wait side by side, each with their own face from [Image 2], and the one who arrives hugs them both together.
If [Image 2] shows a child, keep the same child at the same age and size, with the face from [Image 2] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, cheeks, skin tone, hair color, hair length and hairstyle), never an older child or an adult.
If [Image 2] shows an animal, the one who waits is that animal on four legs, with its own face, fur, markings and size, never a person.
Never blend their faces, never swap their clothes. Each face stays the same from the first frame to the last, so the family recognizes them at once.

The shots:
1. 0-3 s: a medium shot from the side: the one who arrives runs lightly across the soft clouds, looking around in wonder, hair moving in the breeze, then slows down.
2. 3-6 s: a medium close-up, the face turned three-quarters to the camera: they stop, breathless, look ahead, and their eyes fill with tears as they recognize someone, with a trembling smile.
3. 6-10 s: over their shoulder, a few steps away in a beam of warm golden light, the one who waits stands with open arms and a warm smile. The one who arrives runs into their arms and they hug tightly, swaying gently; with a child or an animal, the one who arrives kneels down to hold them. The camera moves in to a medium close-up as they lean back a little and touch foreheads, eyes closed, with quiet happy tears, both faces in three-quarter view to the camera.

Audio: an original slow, tender piano melody with soft strings, a soft breeze, light quick footsteps, then a quiet sob and a soft laugh in the hug. No dialogue, no lyrics.

Only the one who arrives and the one who waits, nobody else. No wings, no halos, no angels, no gates, no religious symbols. No text, no subtitles, no logos, no watermark.
